_about: Hand-labeled ground truth for the free-text lens (recommender_plan.md §3 lens 3). Each entry is a natural-language query plus the course_ids a human judges clearly on-topic. This is the ONLY ground truth for recommend_by_text; it is curated, small, and necessarily incomplete — absence from a relevant set is not evidence of irrelevance, so treat recall here as a relative signal across techniques, not an absolute. Validate/maintain with scripts/build_judged_queries.py.
